d: Bihar sarkar ki mantri shreysi sinh ne aagami 2 disanbar se shuru hone vale bihar stet gems 2026 ko lekar aham jankari sajha ki hai. midiya se batchit karte hue unhonne bataya ki bihar pahli bar apne stet gems ki mejbani karne ja raha hai, jo rajy ke khilariyon aur khel sanskriti ke lie ek aitihasik kadam sabit hoga. "patna aur rajgir men 24 spardhaon men bhag lenge 5,000 khilari":mantri shreysi sinh ne apne bayan men kaha ki is aayojan men patna aur rajgir ke khel parisron men 24 vibhinn khel spardhaon ke tahat 5,000 khilari hissa lenge. unhonne bataya ki is manch ka mukhy uddeshy rajy ki…
